The current codebase makes use of the zero-length array language
extension to the C90 standard
column2: but the preferred mechanism to declare

column1: variable-length types such as these ones is a flexible array member[1][2]
introduced in C99:
struct foo {
int stuff;
struct boo array[];
By making use of the mechanism above
column2: we will get a compiler warning

column1: in case the flexible array does not occur last in the structure
will help us prevent some kind of undefined behavior bugs from being
inadvertenly introduced[3] to the codebase from now on.
This issue was found with the help of Coccinelle.
